jamie_support: Heads up — Capella says their CSV usage export for 2024-06-15 is missing the 12:00-12:59 UTC hour rows. They pulled the file from S3 at ~13:10 UTC and attached counts: dashboard shows 13,450 tokens for the day, invoice shows 14,812 tokens. Raw CSV (what they downloaded) matches dashboard (13,450). Customer insists invoice is correct and that the CSV is missing lines. S3 path: s3://exports/prod/capella/2024-06-15/export-20240615.csv. Can someone help triage?

export-bot: Export job completed: export-id=exp_73829 node=exporter-03 duration=42s status=SUCCESS

lina_billing: Looking at the ledger, invoice number INV-20240630-988 shows token usage 14,812. Sometimes late-ingested events appear in billing but not in early CSVs if an aggregation/backfill happened after the export was generated. Do we know whether they downloaded the "raw" export or an "aggregated" report? Please attach the first ~20 lines of the CSV.

jamie_support: They downloaded the raw S3 CSV. Snippet attached below (first 12 lines):

```
customer_id,timestamp,request_id,input_tokens,output_tokens,total_tokens
capella,2024-06-15T00:02:14Z,req-0a1,12,34,46
capella,2024-06-15T00:15:02Z,req-0b2,8,10,18
capella,2024-06-15T11:58:23Z,req-abc,14,66,80
capella,2024-06-15T13:04:11Z,req-def,120,300,420
... (no rows between 2024-06-15T12:00:00Z and 2024-06-15T12:59:59Z)
```

Also attaching the export manifest lines pointing to chunks:
```
chunks: [export_chunk_0007.csv, export_chunk_0008.csv, export_chunk_0009.csv]
requested_at: 2024-06-15T13:05:12Z
```

sre_tai: Can someone paste the export job metadata (exp_73829) and aggregator commit logs for the 12:00 hour? My hypothesis: aggregator missed committing the 12:00 window and a later backfill wrote into billing-only tables, so invoice has the extra tokens but the CSV was generated from an earlier snapshot. Quick triage steps I need: 1) grep ingestion logs for capella and hour 2024-06-15T12:00:00Z..12:59:59Z 2) run SQL: `SELECT count(*), SUM(total_tokens) FROM raw_events WHERE customer_id='capella' AND event_time >= '2024-06-15T12:00:00Z' AND event_time < '2024-06-15T13:00:00Z';` 3) check aggregator commit log for commit failures/tombstones.

jamie_support: Running point 2 now. CURL I used to download the CSV in case someone wants to repro: `curl -sS -o export.csv "https://s3.amazonaws.com/exports/prod/capella/2024-06-15/export-20240615.csv" && head -n 40 export.csv`

lina_billing: Invoice delta is +1,362 tokens compared to CSV (14,812 - 13,450 = 1,362). That's consistent with ~20-30 short requests. Could be delayed ingestion from the app. Customer claim: their app logs show traffic at 12:32 UTC. Can we search for those request IDs?

customer_acct_rep: Customer forwarded an app log showing a batch of requests around 12:32:14Z with request id prefix `req-32x`. They attached a sample request id `req-32x-7a`. They want confirmation whether those requests made it to our backend.

sre_tai: I'll grep the ingress/ingest logs now: `grep "req-32x-7a" /var/log/ingest/*2024-06-15* || true` — if present we'll have the raw_event. Also check consumer lag around that time: `kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group aggregator --bootstrap-server kafka:9092` to see if any partitions had lag spikes ~12:30. If ingestion was delayed >10m, events could have been backfilled to billing later.

jamie_support: Quick query results: `SELECT SUM(total_tokens) FROM raw_events WHERE customer_id='capella' AND event_time >= '2024-06-15T12:00:00Z' AND event_time < '2024-06-15T13:00:00Z';` -> 1362 (matches invoice delta). But `SELECT SUM(total_tokens) FROM aggregates_hourly WHERE customer_id='capella' AND hour='2024-06-15T12:00:00Z';` -> 0 (no row). Aggregator log shows this snippet:
```
[2024-06-15T12:02:10Z] aggregator-worker-07 ERROR commitWindow hour=2024-06-15T12:00:00Z reason="panic GC pause" stack=...
[2024-06-15T12:02:11Z] aggregator-worker-07 INFO shutting down during window
```
This looks like the aggregator died mid-window and never committed the 12:00 hourly aggregate. Later backfill consumed the raw events and wrote to billing tables (ledger) but the export generator grabbed the aggregated snapshot before the backfill finished.

sre_tai: Confirmed on logs — aggregator-worker-07 had a >30s stop-the-world GC around 12:02 that caused the commit to fail. Backfill job `backfill-agg-20240615` ran at 12:40 and repopulated aggregates/billing, which is why the invoice includes those tokens. Export generator ran at 13:05 and used the aggregates snapshot generated at 13:00 which apparently hadn't incorporated backfill artifacts yet due to race with export manifest generation.

jamie_support: Proposed immediate remediation for support: 1) regenerate the CSV from the post-backfill aggregates and upload to the same S3 path (or a new path with note) so customer can download a file matching invoice; 2) include an explanation and an apology; 3) offer to apply a one-time invoice adjustment if customer prefers (pending @lina_billing).

sre_tai: Longer-term engineering actions: - adjust export-generator to prefer aggregates but fall back to raw_events for any hour where aggregates_hourly row is missing for the customer - add a small delay/consistency check before marking export manifest SUCCESS if there were recent backfill jobs for the same day - add alert to flag aggregator-worker restarts/GC pauses during commit windows. I'll open a runtime issue.

lina_billing: For this customer I'll prepare a provisional credit calculation: credit_tokens = invoice_tokens - exported_tokens = 1,362. I'll compute monetary value and loop in finance. We'll only commit credit once regenerated CSV confirms the delta. Approved to offer temporary credit if customer is pressuring. :thumbsup:

customer_acct_rep: Told customer we'll regenerate the CSV and follow up within 4 hours. They replied with :relieved: and asked for confirmation when file is uploaded.

jamie_support: Action items: - @sre_tai open ENG-XXXXX to track export-generator fallback fix + aggregator alerts - @lina_billing prepare credit calc and finance ticket - I'll regenerate CSV now from post-backfill snapshot and upload to s3://exports/prod/capella/2024-06-15/export-20240615-regenerated.csv and send to customer. I'll post the link here when done.

sre_tai: I'll also add a short-runbook for Support: if aggregates_hourly missing but raw_events present -> regenerate export and notify billing. Will post PR with runbook link once created.

jamie_support: Uploaded regenerated file: s3://exports/prod/capella/2024-06-15/export-20240615-regenerated.csv — difference check: `csvtotals export-20240615.csv export-20240615-regenerated.csv` -> shows +1362 tokens in regenerated file which matches invoice. Sent customer message and waiting for confirmation.

lina_billing: Finance looped in, provisional credit approved pending final verification. Marking this as support-escalation-resolved once customer confirms download.

customer_acct_rep: Customer confirmed download and that numbers now match invoice. They said they'd welcome a short postmortem.

jamie_support: Closing here for now. Will create small postmortem note and link to ENG-XXXXX when it's created. Thanks everyone. :eyes:
